name: crewmarshal
description: Multi-agent delivery discipline: the coordinator architects and reviews while external executors implement, under adversarial review-to-GO and real-runtime verification.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation, keep the review discipline
interface.longDescription: A delivery discipline for work where the coordinator designs, reviews, and verifies while external coding agents implement. Covers system profiling, request tiering, phased roadmaps, workforce management, per-task checkpoints, adversarial review, and session handoff.
defaultPrompt: Set up a system profile for this project before we design anything.
Plan this rebuild as phases from the foundation up.
Hand this task to an executor and verify the result properly.
